layers.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
layers.process: Tripura is not listed in the Third (Protected Areas) or Fourth (Restricted Areas) Schedule of the Immigration and Foreigners Order 2025, so no state-wide Protected or Restricted Area Permit applies. e-Visa holders can enter India at the Agartala land port (MHA list of 10 August 2026).

sources.title: Immigration and Foreigners Order, 2025 (S.O. 3986(E), 1 September 2025)
sources.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (Gazette of India copy hosted by the High Court of Tripura)
sources.supports: paragraph 14 (permit to enter or stay, e-FRRO or Su-Swagatam application, electronic permit, civil authority conditions incl. photography); Third Schedule (Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim entire state); Fourth Schedule (no Assam, Meghalaya or Tripura entries) (read directly)

sources.title: List of international ports enabling entry of e-Visa holders (10 August 2026)
sources.authority: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Home Affairs
sources.supports: 88 e-Visa entry points; airports include Bagdogra and Guwahati; land ports include Jaigaon, Darranga, Dawki, Agartala and Moreh (newly added) (read directly)

zone-requirements.note: Permits for neighbouring states (Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram) are needed before crossing into them. Prohibited places under the Official Secrets Act still need permission.

culture-cycles.note: Bank holidays notified for the RBI Agartala office for 2026; state government offices usually close on these days too, but the state's own gazette list can differ. Where RBI shows several festival names for one day, the label lists all of them; the one that applies here is the festival observed in this state. Dates before 5 November 2026 have passed; replace with the 2027 list when RBI publishes it. Lunar and Islamic dates move each year.
